zh: 新增未來領取規劃，正確處理「10年後每年拿4萬，拿4年」及「到永遠」；未來每年收入不再被當成目前每月工資。保留缺失及矛盾條件追問，展示準備期、首次領取年、年供/月供/一次性投入路線及每日預算。永續只是固定回報高於領取增長的數學假設，並非產品保證。
新增風險預算投資入口，保留每年1萬等投入單位；年期不明時追問。配置只是在已列明的5%權重網格和壓力假設下比較，不宣稱真實市場收益最大化或保證10%最大回撤。
新增衣食住行目標儲蓄：教育、旅行、搬屋/首期、衣物、飲食、買車及醫療預備金；半年正確按6個月計算，可納入目標通脹。
儲蓄保險新增用途及固定連續領取年數；教育海報顯示足額覆蓋的期數、年供與每日預算，不再因為使用保險就稱為傳承。未指定產品條款時不自動套用4%保費回贈。計劃領取、實際領取及缺口分開處理。
分段領取改為可新增/刪除的表單：起止年份、開放年期、提取百分比快選及實際金額預覽；重疊、倒序及非法比例會阻止錯誤方案分享。舊文字輸入移到進階區。
分析書新增完整逐年供款、實領、剩餘价值、IRR與缺口，以及相同投入/提款要求下的2%定期比較。可改比較回報，提供剩餘資產和累計收益兩張獨立曲線、比較方案逐年缺口；回贈只屬保單外现金，不重複加入保單余额。
修復長期月度現金流在IRR負利率邊界計算時的無限大相減問題，改用穩定Horner求值；新增獨立年金公式、用戶原句、否定/矛盾條件、長者操作、大字手機及實際海報/分析書渲染回歸。
將每次必做的角色對抗審查、評分、修正、視覺檢查及正式發布驗證写入AGENTS.md與docs/PERSONA_REVIEW_SOP.md。完整自動測試160項通過，實際渲染與審查記錄保留於項目。
en: Added future-income planning for finite payouts and perpetual-income assumptions. Annual future targets are no longer misclassified as current monthly salary. Missing or conflicting inputs remain questions; the result shows timing, lump-sum/annual/monthly funding and a daily budget equivalent.
Added risk-budget funding with annual contribution preservation and an explicitly bounded illustrative allocation grid. It is not historical optimization or a maximum-drawdown guarantee.
Added everyday goal savings for education, travel, housing, clothing, food, transport and medical reserves, including month-accurate horizons and optional cost inflation.

Insurance planning now supports explicit purpose and consecutive payout years. Education posters show fully funded payout counts rather than legacy labels. Generic projections no longer invent a 4% rebate. Requested payouts, actual payouts and shortfalls are separate.

Replaced mandatory text-based withdrawal schedules with editable year/rate stages, add/remove controls, percentage presets, amount previews and overlap/range validation. Legacy text entry remains under Advanced.

Expanded analysis books with complete annual funding, payouts, residual value, IRR and gaps; editable hypothetical bank/cash/bond/growth comparisons use identical funding and payout requests. Separate residual-asset and cumulative-gain charts avoid disguising unfunded payouts or double-counting rebates.
Stabilized long-period IRR evaluation with Horner forms and added independent-formula, real-input, contradictory-input, elder form, large-text phone and rendered-report regressions.

Recorded the required persona review, scoring, improvement, visual QA and release verification SOP in the repository. All 160 automated tests pass; review and actual render evidence are recorded in the project.
